articleTitle: Multi-objective real-time vehicle detection method based on yolov5
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Object detection is a very important task in artificial intelligence and deep learning. Its purpose is to automatically locate the position of an object in a picture and mark the type of the object. In order to solve the problem that the number of false checks in the process of traditional detection methods is too large to affect the accuracy of detection results, a multi-objective real-time detection method for vehicles based on yolov5 is designed. The design of vehicle multi-target real-time detection method is completed by building vehicle multi-target detection model based on yolov5, acquiring vehicle video image information and real-time vehicle multi-target tracking detection. Through comparative experiments, it is further proved that the designed detection method can effectively reduce the number of false checks, improve the accuracy of monitoring results, and meet the accuracy requirements of the Intelligent Transportation Command Center for vehicle information acquisition.

articleTitle: Classification of nutrient deficiency in rice based on CNN model with Reinforcement Learning augmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Rice is an important crop for agricultural production. Because of the vulnerability of rice, it is likely to be affected by many external conditions. Particularly, rice may lack of various kinds of nutrition elements such as potassium, nitrogen, and phosphorus. For people who are not experienced in botany, it is hard for them to identify nutrition deficiency and add corresponding supplement. Symptoms of nutrient deficiencies in rice plants often are usually represented by phenotype of the leaves. Therefore, the phenotype of leaves can be examined to identify nutrition deficiency. Our goal is to utilize deep learning, specifically, convolutional neural network (CNN), and combine reinforcement learning to help people to address this problem. Experiments were conducted with a dataset containing 1,500 images of rice leaves subject to three different types of nutrition deficiency—nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K) deficiencies. This research preprocesses images first, constructs different CNN architectures, trains the model, and compares the results. With the reinforcement learning augmentation, experiments indicate that Densenet-121 is the best deep CNN model among these structures we had trained to identify what nutrition does a plant’s leave lack of with a test accuracy of 97%. This study demonstrates Densenet-121 model is a good tool to diagnose nutrient deficiency in crops and attempts to incorporate reinforcement learning to augment inputs.

articleTitle: Face recognition on Raspberry Pi based on MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: At present, face recognition has been widely used, and face recognition in mobile devices has a broad application prospect. We try to detect and extract faces by extracting Haar-like features and then put the face images into the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for training and recognition. We improve the MobileNetV2, use ArcFace for face recognition and classification, and test the CNN face classification program on Raspberry Pi 4B. The training in Raspberry Pi is based on the idea of transfer learning. The features extraction part of the network loads the weight file, and only the fully connected classification layers are trained. Finally, the accuracy of train set and test set reach 99.8% and 94.4% respectively after training 100 epochs in Raspberry Pi. When epoch=10, the accuracy rate reaches the predetermined value. We can consider training 10 epochs in Raspberry Pi, and the total time is about 1h33min.

articleTitle: Estimation of Obesity Levels Based on Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: In recent decades, there has been increasing concern about obesity in adolescents and adults. Obesity can cause many physical health problems and affect people’s quality of life. So people are starting to look at the factors that lead to obesity and predict the emergence of obesity. This research presents an estimation of obesity levels based on eating habits, physical condition, and other factors, using a dataset found on UCI Machine Learning Repository. This dataset contains 17 attributes and 2111 records. The labels of this dataset are classified as Insufficient Weight, Normal Weight, Overweight Level I, Overweight Level II, Obesity Type I, Obesity Type II and Obesity Type III. In this research, three major methods are chosen for prediction: Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, and K Nearest Neighbor. Finally, the result obtained by Decision Trees has the best accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the application of “last-mile” autonomous delivery vehicles in the context of epidemic prevention and control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: With the outbreak prevention and control of New Coronary Pneumonia (NCP), the “last mile” distribution of express has become more difficult. The development of artificial intelligence + logistics can improve the efficiency of logistics delivery to a certain extent. Autonomous delivery vehicle, with their high delivery efficiency, reduced transmission of infection, intelligent service experience and other advantages, have a broad application space in the “last mile” delivery. This study compares the development status of domestic “last-mile” delivery, analyzes the main pain points of “last-mile” delivery during epidemic prevention and control, introduces the development status of domestic unmanned vehicles, and discusses the application scenarios and advantages of unmanned vehicle delivery. Finally, the development suggestions and countermeasures were put forward for unmanned vehicle manufacturers, logistics enterprises and government, etc.

articleTitle: Research on talent cultivation of digital media art major based on “integration of production and education” under the background of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Through the exploration of the in-depth cooperation between the digital media art major and related professional companies in personnel training, the paper analyzes the core competence of the digital media major under the needs of the industry, explores new professional characteristics with the teaching team of the industry, enterprises and colleges, and creates the unique advantages of the major, so as to promote the students to become the professional talents of the information age Art as one of the design pioneer, enhance the ability of professional and market integration. Enhance the market competitiveness of students. In addition to being systematic, the curriculum system under the perspective of industry education integration also needs to be dynamic, that is following the new requirements of industrial structure adjustment. Enterprises, industries and colleges should cooperate closely, and curriculum and practice teaching should also cooperate closely to achieve the effect of collaborative education.

articleTitle: Application of children Artificial Intelligence science popularization books based on Augmented Reality technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Children’s books are enlightenment books for children’s education, and the educational significance of popular science books is even more important. With the development of global intelligent technology, parents pay more attention to children’s intelligent education, and books combined with science and technology become more popular. As one of the important tools in the process of children’s growth, books play an important role in children’s early education. However, most of the popular science books are still natural universe, animal world, military education and other subjects. Today, with the development of intelligent technology, it has become an inevitable thing to carry out artificial intelligence science popularization for children. Therefore, this article uses multimedia technology, uses Kudan SDK to develop AR applications in Unity, explores the application of AR technology in popular science books, and uses artificial intelligence as the theme for creation. It mainly includes the cognitive analysis of artificial intelligence, ar software system design and the design exploration of AR and books for 7-11 year olds, so that children can understand and learn the relevant knowledge of AI in the technical environment.

articleTitle: A Brief Analysis of Retail Customer’s Consumption Experience under the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology empowers the retail industry from different perspectives. While a series of practical applications promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional retail to intelligence, they effectively improve the consumption experience of customers in the retail industry from three aspects: high-quality interaction, strong sense of participation and social value. But at the same time, the application of artificial intelligence in the retail industry also has some moral hazard, and the learning cost is too high for some consumers, which has a negative impact on customers’ consumption experience to a certain extent. In view of this situation, the further in-depth application of artificial intelligence technology in the retail industry must be considered more comprehensively.

articleTitle: Improving Mispronunciation Detection of Mandarin for Tibetan Students Based on the End-To-End Speech Recognition Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Mispronunciation detection is an important part of the Computer-Assisted Pronunciation Training System (CAPT). In this paper, we build a CNN-GRU-CTC acoustic model with Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), convolutional neural network (CNN), and Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) technologies to study the pronunciation error detection of Tibetan students in Mandarin. This approach is end-to-end models, while phonemic or graphemic information, or forced alignment between different linguistic units, are not required. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has achieved better experimental results and can effectively detect mispronunciations. The false rejection rate is 7.26%, the detection accuracy rate is 88.35%, and the combined error rate is 14.91%.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Reinforcement Learning for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Object detection is one of the most fundamental and significant problems in computer vision, and has received great attention in recent years. At the same time, it is applied to various fields, such as Large image processing and Abstract-Object Detection. The aim of Object detection is detecting an instance of the visual certain class (such as humans, bikes) in digital images. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), as a modern machine learning technology, has been greatly inspired by deep learning and reinforcement learning. DRL has both their advantages, excellent perception, and decision-making ability. In this work, we aim to provide a comparative review of deep reinforcement learning for object detection tasks to place different approaches in context.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Coronavirus Vaccines Information Traceability System based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: At the moment of COVID-19’s continuing popularity, vaccination has become a necessary measure to fight against the COVID-19 under the community of common destiny. In order to provide more reliable vaccines traceability information that will not be tampered with and improve the worldwide COVID-19 vaccination management system, we designed and implemented a COVID-19 vaccines information traceability system. The system has three major functions. Firstly, with the help of blockchain technology, the system provides reliable input and query of traceability information for the production and transportation of COVID-19 vaccines. Secondly, it provides the historical injection information of COVID-19 vaccines. Thirdly, it realizes the safe conversion from historical injection information to QR code. The COVID-19 vaccines information traceability system not only allows people to inquire absolutely true vaccines traceability information, but also provides a standardized management platform of the COVID-19 vaccines for citizens and governments all over the world.

articleTitle: The automatic control and monitoring system for the production management process of large-scale breeding farm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: China is a large nation of breeding industry and has a big demand for poultry products. In terms of the level of automation and management of poultry farms, there is a certain gap compared with the developed countries. In this paper, based on the researches on application of automation equipment and Internet technologies, we design a large-scale breeding farm automation control monitoring system by using the upper computer software and the lower computer PLC, which can applied to the whole production management process. Through this system, the farm can greatly reduce the labor cost and improve the automation level of production management process.

articleTitle: An Attentional-based Capsule Neural Network for Sentiment Analysis on Online Reviews
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: As a fundamental task of the natural language processing, sentiment analysis has drawn much attention from researchers. In-depth research has been conducted by previous work in this field and great progress has been made. However, these works fail to capture the emotional information in the text accurately, so it is still difficult to achieve satisfactory results. To address this problem, attentional capsule network (ACN) is proposed, which leverages the attention mechanism and the properties of capsule network to capture sentiment information from online reviews accurately. The experimental results demonstrate that our model is superior to other baselines.

articleTitle: AutoDance: Music Driven Dance Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Dance is a popular entertainment. In machine learning, however, dancing to music is really a challenging problem. Lately, researchers use the transformer model in order to solve this question and present an impressive result. In this paper, based on the music and motion data, we tend to use some feature extraction methods to process the training data and later dig the inner feature of data using the above model and then generate auto dance motion. In addition, we present an innovate idea about this problem by adding music emotion into the model.

articleTitle: A Personalized Recommendation Method of Restaurants based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to build up a recommendation method for the restaurants in Hong Kong. A method with customized percentages on multi factors based on Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is proposed. It would provide the individuals with more dynamic and personalized restaurants recommendations according to their own demand rankings from several dimensions. Utilizing this model, we get a list of restaurant rankings in Hong Kong. The advantages of the method are analyzed through the experimental results.

articleTitle: The Influence and Application of Artificial Intelligence on the Political Development of New Media in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: At present, in the field of artificial intelligence, China and the United States are not only engaged in technological competition, but also in a political war. China’s ideology makes Chinese people accustomed to giving up part of the right of privacy in order to get better public services, and artificial intelligence just needs a huge database. Therefore, the government can use artificial intelligence recommendation technology in the field of new media to guide citizens’ political views, obtain effective data while strengthening national control, promote the development of artificial intelligence technology, and enhance the importance of China’s ideology to a certain extent, so that China can maintain a relatively leading position in the current competition. Based on this, this paper analyzes the influence and application of artificial intelligence on the development of new media politics in China.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of a production line simulation platform based on 89C51 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: In order to improve the engineering and technical personnel, especially college students’ ability of intelligent production line application and programming technology, this paper proposes a low-cost, easy to learn, easy to expand intelligent production line simulation method and system based on 89C51, which can dynamically simulate the operation of intelligent production line. It provides a new idea and method for the cultivation of intelligent production line application programming talents. The development process, implementation scheme, problems encountered and solutions of intelligent production line constructed by 89C51 and the transformation of simulation system code to corresponding real production line are introduced in detail. The results show that the combination of virtual simulation and practical verification can optimize the teaching resources, improve the teaching effect and improve the teaching quality. The platform is practical and closely around the engineering practice, which is conducive to the cultivation of students’ comprehensive ability and innovation consciousness.

articleTitle: Study on the path of cultural communication of the short videos on Shenyang Palace Museum cultural relics derivatives
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Under the background of new cultural industry, short video, as an important carrier of cultural industry, has injected fresh blood into its development. Based upon the online data report, taking the cultural spread of the cultural relics derivatives of the Shenyang Palace Museum as the main as the study object, this paper analyzes the advantages of cultural communication that the communication mechanism of the short video platform produces, combs and analyzes the video data of Shenyang Palace Museum on the short video platform. Finally, on the basis of the good-quality dissemination mechanism of the short video platform, this paper studied the cultural dissemination path of the cultural relics of the Shenyang Palace Museum from four perspectives: IP construction, content production, cultural dissemination, and remaining users.

articleTitle: Acquisition of point spread function of dose distribution in intense pulsed Gamma radiation field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: The intense pulsed radiation field provides experimental environment for the study of various radiation effects, and the radiation field parameters are the important basis for the experimental study. The dose intensity distribution of intense pulsed radiation field must be provided. The analysis object is the information of intensity distribution image. The effect of reconstructing intensity distribution image is the most important means to judge whether the image information is good or bad. In the dose distribution of intense pulse gamma radiation field, the main factor of image blurring is the existence of point spread function. How to obtain the point spread function and establish the point spread degradation model are the premise of image reconstruction. In this paper, the degradation model modeling and reconstruction algorithm are used to analyze the dose distribution image of intense pulse gamma radiation field. A good degradation model can improve the image quality, and the point spread function acquisition is particularly important.

articleTitle: The application of ant colony algorithm in fire evacuation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: With the advancement of science and technology, people’s requirements for quality of life continue to increase, making modern buildings more complex and diverse, not just traditional single structures. Complicated structures have increasingly higher requirements for fire safety. At this stage, our country’s fire emergency rescue system is still in the development stage. Compared with foreign advanced technology and our country’s fire protection system is still in the nearest diversion stage. Once a fire occurs, it is difficult for people to remain calm and unable to maintain order in an emergency, which leads to congestion and even stampede accidents in panic. In addition, the original escape route may be blocked due to heavy smoke or fire. At this time, the application of ant colony algorithm in the escape guidance showed a unique advantage. The algorithm can plan the optimal escape route and guarantee the safety of life to the maximum extent.

articleTitle: New thinking on visual communication design under the background of digital age
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Object: Based on the understanding of the process of fusion of visual communication design and new media, this article explores a new way of thinking about visual communication design in the context of digitalization, so that the development of visual communication design continues to provide new directions. Methods: This article first describes the integration process of visual communication and new media, and secondly explains the development direction of humanization, diversification and innovation of visual communication design in the context of digitalization, and uses examples to assist in rotation. „ Result: In the digital age, with the continuous development of new media technology, visual communication design has already broken the traditional two-dimensional expression and the use of materials, and tends to three-dimensional or multi-dimensional expression, no longer limited to materials and forms of expression, and gradually humanized, Diversified and innovative development,, Conclusion: Visual communication design needs to continuously adjust its own development direction, explore and boldly use brand-new materials, technologies and expressions, inject fresh blood into it, and promote the high integration of domestic visual communication design with multiple disciplines, so as to achieve long-term development.

articleTitle: Shenyang Imperial Palace cultural dissemination effect factors from the perspective of short video
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Following the rapid development of Internet technology, short videos have gradually emerged as an important form to promote the current publicity and promotion of cultural industries. This paper takes the short video of Shenyang Imperial Palace, on the basis of Lasswell’s 5W model and network questionnaire to construct a model of factors influencing the dissemination effect of the cultural short video of Shenyang Palace Museum. Applying multiple regression analysis, the influence of each influencing factor on the dissemination effect was analyzed and screened. The results show that the short video of the quality of expression of the dissemination content, the convenience of the dissemination channel significantly and positively affect the dissemination effect of the Shenyang Imperial Palace culture short video. Consequently, the Shenyang Imperial Palace culture short video dissemination effect influences factor model to improve its short video dissemination effect to provide a certain degree of decision support.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Desk Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: To explore the innovative design of intelligent desk. With researching and analyzing the current situation of intelligent desk, this paper figures out problems and design trends of intelligent desk, and formulates the feasibility of realizing intelligent desk. The demand for intelligent desk is put forward, and the user demand is transformed into design language through demand transformation. The design direction of intelligent desk is defined by design conception logic, and the innovative design scheme of intelligent desk is determined. The scheme is described in detail and analyzed and evaluated. The design of intelligent desk based on the user’s demand and the characteristics of intelligent furniture is in line with the furniture design process and has certain feasibility and has certain reference significance for the design and production of intelligent furniture.

articleTitle: A Development Scheme of Simulation Training Software
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: In order to enable a certain instrument operator to receive as much training as possible during the training process, at the same time, reducing the use loss of equipment, it is planned to develop a set of simulation training software to achieve the above purpose. The software has three functions: one is to complete normal exercise functions, the second is the ability to test and score, the third is to be able to conduct operation guidance. Based on the above ideas, carry out the overall plan design of the software in the early stage. By designing the overall development plan of the software, standardize the specific implementation of the software, clarify the functional requirements that the software should meet, and lay the foundation for subsequent software development.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Fine-grained Sentiment Analysis: A Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: With the recent development of internet technology, the amount of data in social media and online has grown exponentially. It is important for us to conduct Sentiment Analysis upon the massive data that we can collect. While coarse Sentiment Analysis only cares about the polarity of sentiments, it is not sufficient to provide us any more detailed information regarding sentiment and emotion. Among research done in recent years, researchers tend to focus more on Fine-grained Sentiment Analysis, which cares about the polarity of sentiments and the intensity and receptor of sentiments. With the advances of deep learning in recent years and its advantage of independence from manual feature engineering, more and more researchers started to apply it to Sentiment Analysis tasks. This work aims to provide a comparative review of deep learning for Fine-grained Sentiment Analysis tasks to place different approaches in context.

articleTitle: Fast Feature Matching Augmented Reality Method on Dynamic Image Towards Multimedia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: This paper presents an application algorithm for dynamic image augmented reality rendering based on feature extraction of natural regions of images. For the natural features of template and recognition images, an ORB algorithm based on FAST feature point extraction and BRIEF feature vector operator is used to identify and match image features, which can quickly and accurately obtain image feature matching information. The generating dynamic image keyframe extraction by using the interpolation animation technology which can be applied to the dynamic image augmented reality application rendering of mobile camera equipment. The experimental results show that this algorithm can be effectively applied to the fusion rendering based on natural feature recognition, especially in the field of digital culture publishing, the dynamic augmented reality display of static text image information. It expands the dimension of information and has strong application innovation value.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Artificial Intelligence in the Best Relationship Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: The majority of people find it is hard to date people and dating life is not going well. There is a question that how to build a serious relationship with the right person. In this paper, we focus on the investigation of the possible relationships in various subjects and possible factors that influence a serious relationship. The analyzing result of the input data helps in pairing a more accurate person through digital information, which reduces the risk of meeting the one that will hurt people physically or mentally. We have a certain fault tolerance on the AI model, but the chance of finding the best one is boosted as we using the large number of training data set to reduce the error percentage. Meanwhile, this paper discusses the possible AI applications and the model architecture that might be applied in the love story.

articleTitle: Contrastive Loss On Masked Face Verification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: The outbreak of COVID-19 has encouraged people to wear their masks more frequently than ever. However, the absence of much facial information from the masked face will cause failures in many current face recognition and verification functions to recognize the individual’s identity. To tackle this problem precisely, our group builds a modified SimCLR model with the contrastive loss that is able to extract similarity features from individuals regardless of whether a mask is worn. From our experiments, we find out that our usage of contrastive loss leads to a large improvement in the testing verification accuracy compared to a baseline model with the commonly used MSE loss.

articleTitle: Natural Interaction Technology in Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Natural interaction allows a user to interact with a computer system in a parallel and non-precision mode via multiple interactive channels based on own inner perceptions and cognition skills. With the technology of virtual reality(VR), a simulation environment is generated by a computer, the user can investigate or operate objects in the virtual world using natural skills of humans, and intuitional and natural real-time perceptions such as seeing, listening and touching are provided. Brand-new technological support is provided by this technology to natural human-computer interactions. Based on introduction to technological theories of Human-Computer Interactions(HCI), the paper makes elaborate analysis on key technologies and research status quo of multiple natural interaction techniques in virtual reality and comes up with its development prospect in the future.

articleTitle: Key algorithm based on threshold segmentation for attitude correction application in tactical training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: In recent years, image segmentation technology has developed rapidly and become a hot topic in the field of vision. However, image segmentation still suffers from problems such as extracting multiple targets to appear as crops. In order to better solve the problems brought by single-threshold image segmentation, a new method of multi-threshold image segmentation based on the grey wolf optimization algorithm is proposed. The method overcomes the inefficiency and low accuracy of manual image segmentation and the limitations of the single-threshold OTSU(Maximum interclass variance method) algorithm by using the grey wolf optimisation algorithm to optimise, selecting the optimal threshold for segmenting the image and binarise the image into several regions as well as regions of interest. The segmented image can be better used for posture correction for tactical training.

articleTitle: Analysis of Research and Trends in Online Review: A Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Contemporarily, plenty of literatures focus on analyzing the online reviews. According to those online comments, researchers are able to capture lots of the useful information, e.g., posters’ opinions, authenticities of the reviews, and the key information. In order to excavate more concise and comprehensive information, we review different research papers from above aspects. Based on their results and methods, the differences are demonstrated between proposed models from the literature. Moreover, suggestions are given for future research directions, which will be guideline for researchers, especially freshman. Besides, this paper also benefits for consumers to make wise decisions and practitioners to promote market efficiency.

articleTitle: Overfitting-based Bias-generating Neural-network : Simulation of Pavlov’s Dog
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Since the advent of artificial intelligence techniques, many scholars have considered the phenomenon of overfitting to be negative and have worked to eliminate it. However, there are still many scholars who believe that the phenomenon of overfitting is worth exploiting. This paper argues that the phenomenon of overfitting of neural networks can reproduce the process of biologically generated prejudice, and builds a neural network prone to overfitting and applies it to a simple model of a dog. The simulations showed that the behavior of the simulated dog was similar to the conditioned reflexes in Pavlov’s dog experiments. Therefore, this paper argues that the judicious use of overfitting techniques can better enable artificial intelligence to be “each in its way”.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: As a rapidly developing comprehensive information technology, virtual reality technology has great significance for the innovation of landscape design with its powerful functions. This paper expounds on the critical role of virtual reality technology in landscape design from four aspects of interaction mode, scene effect, user perception and precision. It puts forward how to apply this technology to comprehensively integrate design elements to shorten the design period and optimize the design scheme. At the same time, various interactive scenes are simulated to attract public participation and help users complete landscape design schemes in a more accurate, humane and efficient way.

articleTitle: Applications of Cloud Desktop in Library Information System Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: As a new technology in the internet era, cloud desktop has been widely used in library information system construction. The applications of cloud desktop can not only enhance the reader experience, improve the service quality, ensure the information security of readers, but also effectively improve the efficiency and level of library management. This paper analyses the hardware and software requirements of the cloud desktop information system of university library, gives the overall architecture of the cloud desktop library information system, and selects the IDV scheme after comparison. IDV scheme has the advantages of smooth operation, good experience, energy saving and environmental protection and provide more convenient and high-quality information service for teachers and students.

articleTitle: Research on Traditional Media Content Distribution Platform by Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: In the current media living environment, with the rapid development of Internet technology, new media taking the Internet technology Express has become the main way for users to obtain information. At the same time, the traditional media is declining because of the loss of the initiative to control the information channel. What is the development dilemma of traditional media in the new media environment?How can we break through this dilemma?Based on the analysis of the existing problems and development status of traditional media content distribution platform, the author draws the following conclusion that the traditional media can innovate the content distribution platform through four aspects:using algorithm recommendation to change the passive situation of communication platform;Build diversified communication platform to achieve sustainable development;Highlight UGC function of content distribution platform to increase user stickiness;With the help of new media platform to achieve the broken circle effect.

Author Keywords: Technology enabling traditional media content distribution challenges innovation

articleTitle: Research on Active Interaction and User Experience of Community Intelligent Vehicle System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Fueled by the vigorous development of intelligent technology, changes have taken place in man-machine interaction mode. As a result, there appears an active interaction form in the working mode of intelligent products. To this end, with reference to the Theory of Implicit Interaction, this paper rethinks the application and experience effect of active interactive feedback in community settings. Based on the differences in experience arising from the non-verbal feedback of intelligent devices, this paper studies the differences in user experience as a result of different active interaction behaviors such as head movements and body movements in the course of unified and coordinated work between intelligent devices and people. By probing into the differences of user experience from three points of view, i.e., the attraction of movements, empathy of movements, and communication of the sense of trust, we analyzed and summarized the key factors that affect user experience. Furthermore, we verified that the association tightness of interaction behaviors is essential to user experience during human-intelligent robot interaction.

articleTitle: Mining and analysis of hot topics in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: In social media, useful data information is mined to identify hot topics and predict the development direction of hot topics. The research method is to use web crawler to obtain relevant data, find new hot topics in media, get the original data, use Jieba to segment words, generate word segmentation results, obtain eigenvalues through Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) word frequency statistics, and use k-means algorithm to complete the clustering of eigenvalues, obtain the cluster results, and judge the hot topics in the cluster. In the experiment of advanced optimization hot topic, Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) method is used to classify the topic model, Gibbs sampling is used to sample and train the model, and K-means algorithm is used to achieve the purpose of clustering. The recall rate, accuracy rate and F value are calculated, and the experimental results of hot topics are summarized and analyzed to obtain the LDA model results of current hot topics in network media.

articleTitle: Interaction Experience and Expectation Discrepancy of Intelligent Robot in Restaurant Service Scenario
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: The application of intelligent service robots is proliferating in our daily life. In-depth research about interactions between humans and intelligent robots is thus highly required. As the current study noted widely, the discrepancy between user perception and the robot’s actual capability would diminish user experience. Therefore, reasonably expressing robot capability has become a significant problem in designing the interaction mode of robots. This paper investigated the impact of different interaction modes on the user’s perceived capability through simulating HRI in the restaurant scenario. We found in the experiment that the perceived capability surpasses actual capability would not decrease user experience under this context. Furthermore, we analyzed essential factors that affect user experience, served as references for future robot interaction design.

articleTitle: Research on Emotional Interaction Carriers of Driving Assistants in Service Scenarios of Self-Driving Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and its Application on Media (ISAIAM)
abstract: Existing in-vehicle interactive products mainly serve the drivers’ in-vehicle interactive behavior. When self-driving technology is applied to service scenarios in the future, driving behavior is simplified and cars entirely become mobile spaces, then human-computer interaction mode in a car will change and emotional sustenance and connection of passengers in the mobile space will rely more on car interactive products. Overly simple or complicated interactive emotional communication cannot produce a good experience. Based on the future service scenarios in driverless vehicles, this paper analyzes the interaction emotions required by passengers. Using eye movement and abstract emotion methods to compare and test the three existing in-vehicle interactive products (screen, abstract human form, and holographic projection), this research experiments and analyzes the degree of user visual perception when different interactive carriers convey the same emotion. The new technologies and physical assistants in combination will being conveniences for future driverless automobiles to design driving assistants on this basis in service scenarios and build a trusted atmosphere in in-vehicle space. The key factors affecting user experience in the human-vehicle interaction carrier design are summarized, and guidance is provided for the design for self-driving service scenarios.
